rationale: The claimant explicitly reports their bike was stolen, which is a clear case of theft of personal property covered under the renters policy.
claim_summary: Policyholder Blake Okafor (POL-1007, active renters policy) reports their 2024 commuter bike (valued at ~$800) was stolen yesterday morning. The claim is classified as theft with low severity; the $250 deductible applies, leaving an estimated payout of ~$550.
